scope: Full application, independent MIDI framing checks and bounded native tracker round trips; no external player, notation engraving or audible fidelity claim.

results.name: Export service and both actual Audio buttons are present
MIDI is format 1 with conductor and four bounded standard tracks
MIDI channels distinguish crossed pulse pitches, triangle and percussion
MIDI row timing, explicit cuts and note-off before retrigger are exact
MIDI reimport preserves flattened ordered notes, four channels, cuts, volume and speed
MusicXML is uncompressed score-partwise with escaped title and four parts
MusicXML reimport preserves ordered notes, noise values, channels, cuts, volume and speed
All supported speeds round trip exact row boundaries in both formats
Dense XML notes through the final row accept floating timing noise at speeds 5, 10 and 13
Sparse channels keep their identities and trailing silent orders survive
Sustained notes across order boundaries are preserved through one pass
A 16-row score imported into 64-row patterns cuts at row 16 and warns about silent padding
A 64-row score regrouped into 16-row patterns retains its end without extra padding
Score export never edits project, undo history, or runtime enable state
Export leaves generated ROM bytes unchanged
Reimport is an ordinary undoable tracker edit that saves, reopens and builds
Loss warnings explicitly identify SFX, envelopes, timbre and one-pass boundaries
Used tracker effects refuse export atomically
DPCM data refuses export instead of disappearing
Mid-note volume changes and zero-volume note-ons refuse explicitly
Missing patterns, instruments and empty music refuse export
Legal whitespace around XML profile and dynamics attributes preserves channel, speed and volume
Malformed score profiles and edited tempo fail without project changes
Profile channel overlap and off-grid imported edits are rejected
Generic MusicXML without the Forge profile retains legacy six-tick allocation
Cancelling the actual export button creates no download and changes no project
Actual export buttons invoke downloads with clear format status
Cancelling the protected Save As dialog is never reported as a completed export
